name: Stronghold
overview: Scripture reveals that a stronghold represents a spiritual fortress that believers must rely on God to overcome, recognizing Him as their light, salvation, and strength in times of fear (Psalms 27:1). The battle is not against human adversaries but against spiritual forces of darkness and wickedness in high places (Ephesians 6:12). Victory over these strongholds comes through being filled with the Spirit rather than worldly excess (Ephesians 5:18) and through the power of earnest, righteous prayer and mutual confession within the body of Christ (James 5:16).
